title: 2027 Bike Races: California + US Stage Races

methodology.text: Every road event posted on the NCNCA 2027 calendar as of Oct 28, 2026, pulled from its public events feed.
SCNCA 2027 planning calendar, a public Google Calendar that race directors edit. Dates are tentative until each race is permitted. Las Vegas events are left out.

Each race’s official website. Races with no 2027 date yet are listed separately with their 2026 dates from BikeReg. Long-running races with no edition in 2026 (Joe Martin, San Dimas, Mt. Hood, Walla Walla, Chico) are not listed.
One lap traced from a real race GPS file: the site owner’s Strava rides where available, otherwise a racer’s public RideWithGPS upload or the promoter’s course map. Each event names its file.
Sampled every 20–100 m along each path from USGS 3DEP 10 m terrain data, so profiles are comparable across courses. Climb figures for courses the site owner has raced come from Strava segment data.
Driving distance and free-flow time from San Francisco City Hall, routed with OSRM on OpenStreetMap. Real times are longer in traffic.

events.name: Cal Aggie Criterium
events.notes: 1.1 mi park loop in Land Park. Flat; pack finish.

events.name: UC Davis Flatlands Circuit
events.notes: 3.9 mi clockwise loop around University Airport (Hutchison, Hopkins, Levee, Brooks). About 10 corners, potholes, and exposed to 10–20 mph wind. Dead flat.

pathSource.label: Traced from the 2026 race map (Strava activity 17255724828) and routed on OpenStreetMap roads

events.name: Cantua Creek Road Race
events.notes: ~24 mi out-and-back lap on old Hwy 33 (flyer says 26); Cat 3/4 race 3 laps. Drops ~300 ft in the first 3 mi heading north, then ~17 mi of near-flat road with small rollers. The return south climbs at the end: 1.7 mi @ 1.2%, then two 0.8 mi ramps @ 2.7% and 3.3% (+250 ft together) to the uphill finish area.

events.name: Copper Valley Circuit Race
events.notes: 5.2 mi out-and-back. Two ~1 mi drags at ~1% (+50–60 ft each), nothing steeper. A power course.

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: Snelling Road Race
events.notes: 12 mi lap, pan-flat with small rollers; the only sustained rise is a 2.7 mi drag at 0.5%. Rough pavement.

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: SGW Land Park Criterium
events.notes: 1.1 mi park loop in Land Park. Flat; pack finish.

events.name: SGW Bariani Road Race
events.notes: 20 mi flat lap with one 3.6 mi false flat at 1% (+190 ft). Exposed farm roads, so wind does the damage. Most fields race 3 laps.

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2026

events.name: Los Gatos Roofing Cat’s Hill Classic
events.notes: 0.9 mi downtown Los Gatos lap. One climb per lap: Cat’s Hill, 0.2 mi @ 5.4% (+55 ft) with a ~60 m pitch near 19%. Climber’s crit.

events.name: Santa Cruz Classic Criterium
events.notes: 0.77 mi downtown lap with a hairpin. Each lap has a 0.4 mi drag @ 2% (+45 ft) with a short ~9% kick; the rest is flat or downhill.

events.name: Copperopolis Road Race
events.notes: 21.8 mi counterclockwise loop on fair-to-bad pavement. Main climb from mile 2.5: 4.8 mi @ 2.9% (+730 ft) with ramps near 14% for ~100 m. Rollers along the top, then 1.7 mi @ 2.6% (+240 ft) at mile 15.5 to the high point, then a fast, bumpy, twisty descent home.

events.name: Berkeley Hills Road Race
events.notes: Per lap: Mama Bear, 1.1 mi at 5.6% (+330 ft), then Papa Bear, 0.9 mi at 6.6% (+320 ft). The final lap finishes on Papa Bear. Cat 3/4 fields race 3 laps (~56 mi).

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2026

events.name: Berkeley Streets Criterium
events.notes: 0.47 mi lap with a 0.3 mi rise @ 2% (+30 ft). Course shown is the 2022 downtown Berkeley loop; the 2027 listing only says Orinda.

events.name: Golden State Race Series – Time Trial
events.notes: 6 mi out-and-back on Rod Beaudry Dr. Merckx format: road bikes only, no TT gear. Flat.

events.name: Golden State Race Series – Criterium
events.notes: 0.83 mi business-park loop around Cobblerock Dr. Flat, four main corners.

events.name: Golden State Race Series – Circuit
events.notes: 2.1 mi loop from Cobblerock Dr. Flat; ~10 ft of rise per lap.

events.name: Winchester Circuit Race
events.notes: 4.5 mi lap, 4–6 laps (~1 hr). No long climb: nine short punches of 0.1–0.4 mi @ 4–7.5%. The two biggest come late in the lap: 0.4 mi @ 6% (+130 ft), then 0.4 mi @ 7.5% (+170 ft).

events.name: Regalado Road Race
events.notes: 16.8 mi lap with no climb over ~90 ft: a 3.6 mi drag at 0.5% plus several 0.4–1.2 mi bumps at 1.3–2.5%. Fast, exposed and often windy.

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: Dash for Cash
events.notes: 0.8 mi business-park rectangle in Pleasanton. Dead flat. Lots of cash primes.

events.name: Helen Pool Fourth of July Criterium
events.notes: 0.7 mi downtown Davis loop. Flat.

events.name: AVRT Pescadero Road Race
events.notes: Per lap: two Stage Rd kickers (1.1 mi at ~4.5%, +265 ft; 0.8 mi at ~7%, +290 ft), then Haskins Hill, 1.5 mi at 7% (+565 ft). The final lap finishes on top of Haskins. Cat 3/4 fields race 2 laps (~55 mi).

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: Patterson Pass Road Race
events.notes: Per lap: Patterson Pass, 3.4 mi at 5.6% (+1,020 ft), Flynn Rd, 2.3 mi at 4.4% (+530 ft), and the Midway bump, 1.0 mi at 4% (+210 ft). Usually windy. Cat 3/4 fields race 3 laps (~65 mi).

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: Shea Center Criterium
events.notes: 0.63 mi business-park square in Livermore. Flat, four corners.

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: Winters Criterium
events.notes: 0.57 mi L-shaped downtown loop. Flat.

events.name: Winters Road Race
events.notes: One climb per lap on Cantelow Rd: 5.4 mi at 2.5% (+725 ft). It starts as a 2.9 mi run-in at ~1%, then 2.5 mi at 4.2%, ending in 0.6 mi at 6.4%. The rest is flat to rolling. Cat 3/4 fields race 3 laps (~72 mi).

pathSource.label: Race GPS file from the site owner (Strava), 2025

events.name: Montage Wellness – Sand City Criterium
events.notes: 0.68 mi loop with one short rise (~30 ft) per lap.

events.name: Il Giro di San Francisco
events.notes: 0.78 mi L-shaped lap at Levi’s Plaza. One rise per lap: 0.2 mi @ ~2% (+25 ft) with a short ~6% pitch.

events.name: Oakland Grand Prix
events.notes: 0.64 mi downtown loop at Franklin & 21st. ~20 ft of rise per lap; flat.

events.name: SoCal Early Birds – Redlands
events.notes: Early-season training crits at the Redlands Sports Complex. Course file not found.

events.name: CBR Criterium Series (#1–#6)
events.notes: 0.89 mi loop at Cal State Dominguez Hills. Flat; under 30 ft of rise per lap. Six dates through June.

events.name: Santa Barbara County Road Race
events.notes: 14.2 mi lap, ~570 ft. Opens with a 2.2 mi climb at 2.3% (+260 ft), then a long 7.5 mi drag at 0.6%. Steepest pitch ~6%.

events.name: Cal Poly Criterium
events.notes: 1.0 mi loop on the Cal Poly SLO campus. Flat; about 20 ft of rise per lap.

events.name: Brea GP
events.notes: Criterium in Brea. Course file not found.

events.name: Roger Millikan Memorial (CBR)
events.notes: 1.66 mi long course at Dominguez Hills (2026 layout). One gentle rise per lap, ~0.7 mi at <1%.

events.name: Rosena Ranch Circuit Race
events.notes: 3.7 mi lap at ~2,000 ft elevation, ~180 ft of climbing per lap in two drags (1.0 mi and 1.4 mi at ~1.3%). Two dates.

events.name: LAX Circuit Race
events.notes: 3.7 mi lap beside LAX. Flat; about 80 ft of gentle rollers per lap.

events.name: Orange Show Criterium
events.notes: Criterium at the National Orange Show grounds. Course file not found.

events.notes: Venue not listed yet. Course file not found.

events.notes: 0.79 mi loop in Barrio Logan. Mostly flat, one short rise (~17 ft) per lap.

events.name: JKC Memorial Hunte Parkway Road Race
events.notes: 2.8 mi circuit on Hunte Parkway, ~140 ft per lap. Main rise 0.5 mi at 2.2%. Note: the SCNCA event listing says May 8 while the planning calendar says May 16.
